plainTranslation: Magnetic across a gap. Opposite styles of wanting - one pursues, one receives - and that polarity is exactly the draw. Failure mode: swinging between chase and retreat until both are worn out. Meet in the middle on purpose instead of acting out the chase.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryShort: Desire and affection are there, but the timing or the approach keeps clashing.
summaryDeep: Desire and affection are there, but the timing or the approach keeps clashing. Attraction and irritation coexist. Talk about pace and pursuit directly.
tension: Failure mode: only feeling the romance when there is friction, distance, or someone to win over. Once things get simple, the connection may start looking for a new problem.
advice: Say what you want directly. Don't make the other person figure it out from hints, timing, or attitude.
